trust_decision.summary: The Cline Hub dashboard server decides whether a browser may open the /browser WebSocket (which drives sessions, provider settings, desktop commands and hub restart). At the pinned commit it checks only the optional roomSecret query parameter and never checks Origin or Host. The fix adds a server-wide gate that checks Host and Origin against an allowlist built from PUBLIC_URL, the bind host and loopback aliases.

landing_point.why: The advisory names the `/browser` endpoint, and this branch is the only WebSocket upgrade in the dashboard. Its only guard is the roomSecret check at apps/cline-hub/src/server.ts:62-65.

fix_sites.entry_point: Dashboard HTTP fetch handler, every request (Bun.serve fetch): a new server-wide gate before routing, covering the WebSocket upgrade at /browser, unsafe methods and unknown paths (fix.diff:118-132)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: options.ts is env-parsing and startup code with no auth logic, and the advisory is about a WebSocket handler. A solver would not expect that the PUBLIC_URL normalisation has to change for an origin allowlist to accept the legitimate dashboard (for example PUBLIC_URL=http://<tailscale-ip> with port 8787).

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: The same-origin dashboard must keep working. The SPA and its static assets load via GETs with no Origin header. The WebSocket must accept localhost, 127.0.0.1 and [::1] aliases on a local bind, and the PUBLIC_URL/tunnel origin plus the explicit bind origin on a 0.0.0.0 bind with ROOM_SECRET. Origins with default ports 80/443 have no port. An over-broad fix (requiring Origin on every request, or allowing only the exact PUBLIC_URL origin) breaks page load or the alias/tunnel connections.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second WebSocket upgrade path (for example a read-only event/stream socket) that calls server.upgrade without the /browser guard.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Bun.serve handles all upgrades in this one fetch function. A maintainer adding a socket for a narrower feature could reasonably skip the guard as 'read-only'.
